## Zone Overview & Access Gating

The Plane of Disease is a decaying, pustulent realm presided over by Bertoxxulous' vile creation, **Grummus**. Progression into Tier 2's **Crypt of Decay (Ruins of Lxanvom)** requires navigating through the foul depths of the castle, defeating Grummus, and hailing the Planar Projection to gain ward protection against Bertoxxulous' pestilence.

---

## Raid Encounter: Grummus

* **Script:** [`quests/podisease/#Grummus.lua`](file:///c:/code/EQMacEmu/quests/podisease/%23Grummus.lua)
* **Location:** Deep within the subterranean crypts of the castle at `(165, -1650, -45)`.
* **Prerequisites:** None.

### NPC Roster

| NPC Name | NPC ID | Role | Level / Class | HP / Max Hit | Key Spells & Abilities |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [#Grummus](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/205156) | `205156` | Raid Boss | 65 Warrior | ~250,000 HP / 1100 | Summon, Enrage, Rampage, Procs Disease DoTs |
| [A Planar Projection](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/205156) | `205156` | Progression Flagger | 1 Untargetable | Invulnerable | Grants `grummus` & `fuirstel` flags on hail (20m despawn) |

### Combat Mechanics & Tactics

1. **Trash Clearing & Pulling:** The crypt leading up to Grummus contains tightly packed puslings, bubonians, and malodorous fiends. Clear thoroughly before pulling Grummus to avoid train wipes.
2. **Disease AEs & Procs:** Grummus procs potent disease effects that drain mana and health. Shamans and Clerics must maintain high Disease Resistance buffs and be prepared to cast group disease cures.
3. **Tanking & Rampage:** Single target Rampage. Healers should assign an off-tank healer to keep the highest secondary melee alive.
4. **Victory & Planar Projection:**
   - Upon death, [A Planar Projection](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/205156) immediately spawns at Grummus' corpse location.
   - The Projection lasts for **20 minutes** (`1,200,000 ms`).
   - Every raid member must hail the projection to receive the character flag:
     > *"The Planar Projection tells you, 'Now that Grummus has fallen, you must pass into the plane of Bertoxxulous. Deep inside of this castle you will find a room with a large decaying pipe. Push it out of the way and jump into the very plague that is Bertoxxulous' home. Be wary in your travels, for his pestilence shall consume you.'"*
   - Once flagged, raiders can click the large decaying pipe in the back room to zone directly into the Crypt of Decay (`codecay`).

---

## Mini-Raid Encounter: Rallius Rattican (Ratboss Event)

* **Script:** [`quests/podisease/encounters/Ratboss.lua`](file:///c:/code/EQMacEmu/quests/podisease/encounters/Ratboss.lua)
* **Location:** Lower diseased sewers at `(96, -3384, -214)`.

### NPC Roster

| NPC Name | NPC ID | Role | Level / Class | Key Mechanics |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [#Rallius Rattican](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/205134) | `205134` | Event Boss | 62 Warrior | Spawns spiders and cronie waves on combat engage |
| [A gargantuan arachnae](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/205159) | `205159` | Add (x2) | 58 Warrior | Spawns at `(96, -3384)` and `(-539, -3482)` on pull |
| [a bubonian cronie](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/205160) | `205160` | Wave Add | 55 Warrior | Spawns in pairs every 290 seconds |
| [A bubonian youth](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/205161) | `205161` | Swarm Add | 50 Warrior | Pack of 3–6 rats spawned every 360 seconds |

### Event Timers & Flow

```
Rallius Rattican Engaged
  |
  +--> Spawns 2x [A gargantuan arachnae] immediately
  +--> Timer: 'cronies' (Initial: 1s, Recast: 290s) -> Spawns 2x bubonian cronies
  +--> Timer: 'youth'   (Initial: 150s, Recast: 360s) -> Spawns 3-6x bubonian youth pack
  +--> Timer: 'reset'   (1200s / 20 min out-of-combat fail timer)
```

* **Add Priority:** When engaged, two giant arachnae immediately spawn. Off-tanks must peel them while crowd control locks down the cronies.
* **Youth Swarms:** Every 6 minutes, a swarm of 3 to 6 bubonian youths spawn directly on Rallius and path into the fight. Point-blank AE damage (Wizards/Mages) quickly clears them out.
* **Reset Condition:** If combat drops, a 20-minute reset timer ticks. If not re-engaged, all adds depop and the event completely resets.

---

## Mini Encounter: Aramin the Spider Guardian

* **Script:** [`quests/podisease/#Aramin_the_Spider_Guardian.lua`](file:///c:/code/EQMacEmu/quests/podisease/%23Aramin_the_Spider_Guardian.lua)
* **Adds:** Spawns [An Arachnae Maleveler](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/205157) (`205157`) and [An Arachnae Serioun](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/205158) (`205158`).
* Level 60 mini-boss guarding the spider tunnels. Adds despawn after 5 minutes if unengaged.

---

## Raid Leader Quick Cheat-Sheet

* **Buff Priorities:** Cast maximum Disease Resistance buffs (Resist Disease, Pure Blood) and have Shaman/Cleric disease cure hotkeys ready.
* **Grummus Pull:** Pull Grummus to the bottom room ramp to prevent adds from patrolling into the fight.
* **Flag Collection:** Remind all 72 raiders that **everyone must hail the Planar Projection** before leaving the room, or they will be unable to enter the Crypt of Decay pipe.

## Zone Overview & Access Gating

The Plane of Innovation is a clockwork factory realm designed by the gnomes and gods of invention. While the outer junkyard is open to all mortals, the inner **Factory** is sealed behind massive iron blast doors. 

There are two distinct paths to unlock the Factory Door (`poi_door`):
1. **The Raid Escort:** Assist Nitram Anizok in the junkyard and destroy **Xanamech Nezmirthafen** (The Clockwork Dragon).
2. **The Endurance Test:** Complete the group **Endurance Testing Room** inside the factory annex.

Once inside the Factory, raids can challenge the **Manaetic Behemoth**, the critical Tier 1 gatekeeper boss who awards access to **The Plane of Tactics (Drunder, Fortress of Zek)**.

---

## Major Raid Encounter: Manaetic Behemoth

* **Script:** [`quests/poinnovation/encounters/Behemoth.lua`](file:///c:/code/EQMacEmu/quests/poinnovation/encounters/Behemoth.lua)
* **Location:** The Central Assembly Reactor inside the Factory at `(1050, 0, -50)`.
* **Prerequisite:** Factory Door Flag (`poi_door`).

### NPC Roster

| NPC Name | NPC ID | Role | Level / Class | HP / Max Hit | Key Spells & Abilities |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [Manaetic Behemoth](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/206046) | `206046` | Raid Boss | 67 Warrior | ~450,000 HP / 1400 | Summon, Enrage, Area Rampage, AE Nukes |
| [#Weapon Event Master](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/206197) | `206197` | Controller | 70 Warrior | Untargetable | Manages 48s wave spawns |
| [a clockwork device](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/206001) | `206001` | Wave Add | 60 Warrior | ~35,000 HP | Fast moving robotic adds |
| [#Giwin Mirakon](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/206203) | `206203` | Progression Flagger | 65 Rogue | Untargetable | Spawns upon Behemoth death; grants Tactics flag |

### Wave Progression & Boss Mechanics

```
Engage Assembly Room Controller
  |
  +--> Timer: 'wave' (Every 48 seconds)
  |      Spawns 6x [a clockwork device] from 1 of 8 radial tunnels
  |      Clockworks march along path grids toward the center reactor
  |
  +--> Behemoth Activates
         Casts [Boom] (Spell 2321: 1500 DD Fire PBAoE)
         Casts [Rain of Fire] (Spell 1080: 800 Fire Rain)
         Area Rampage active
```

1. **Clockwork Interception:** Every 48 seconds, 6 clockworks march inward. If too many clockworks reach the center, they supercharge the Behemoth's mana core. Enchanters must stun/mez while melee burst them down.
2. **Behemoth Burn:** When Manaetic Behemoth activates, the main tank establishes aggro with back to a wall. Due to **Area Rampage**, melee DPS must attack from maximum melee range and healers must keep group heals rolling against [Boom](https://www.pqdi.cc/spell/2321).
3. **Reset:** If the raid wipes, a 10-minute retry timer (`600,000 ms`) begins. If unengaged, the room resets completely.
4. **Planar Progression Flag:**
   - On death, [#Giwin Mirakon](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/206203) spawns.
   - Up to 72 raid members hail Giwin:
     > *"Giwin Mirakon tells you, 'You have done well to disable this mechanical terror. With this engine destroyed, you are ready to face the armies of War in Drunder!'"*
   - Awards the character flag granting access to **The Plane of Tactics (`potactics`)**.

---

## Raid Escort Encounter: Xanamech Nezmirthafen (Clockwork Dragon)

* **Script:** [`quests/poinnovation/Nitram_Anizok.lua`](file:///c:/code/EQMacEmu/quests/poinnovation/Nitram_Anizok.lua) & [`#Xanamech_Nezmirthafen.lua`](file:///c:/code/EQMacEmu/quests/poinnovation/%23Xanamech_Nezmirthafen.lua)
* **Location:** Junkyard scrap mounds at `(-500, 1200, 20)`.

### NPC Roster

| NPC Name | NPC ID | Role | Level / Class | HP / Max Hit | Key Spells & Abilities |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [Nitram Anizok](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/206208) | `206208` | Escort NPC | 65 Gnome | Vulnerable | Walks through scrap fields to dragon heap |
| [#Xanamech Nezmirthafen](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/206033) | `206033` | Raid Boss | 65 Dragon | ~300,000 HP / 1200 | Summon, Enrage, AE Fear, Dragon Breath |

### Event Walkthrough

1. **Component Turn-in:** Hand Nitram Anizok the 3 required parts from the junkyard:
   - [copper node](https://www.pqdi.cc/item/9246) (`9246`)
   - [bundle of super conductive wires](https://www.pqdi.cc/item/9247) (`9247`)
   - [intact power cell](https://www.pqdi.cc/item/9248) (`9248`)
2. **Escort Phase:** Nitram starts pathing across the dangerous scrap fields. The raid must clear all roaming clockworks ahead of him. If Nitram dies, the event fails.
3. **Dragon Awakening:** Nitram arrives at the scrap mound and completes the machine. [#Xanamech Nezmirthafen](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/206033) powers up, lets out a mechanical roar, and attacks.
4. **Dragon Fight:** Maintain dragon positioning (tanks take head, raid stacks on flank/belly to avoid tail whip and frontal breath). Keep high Magic Resist against AE Fear.
5. **Factory Flag:** When Xanamech dies, Nitram Anizok flags up to 72 players for `poi_door`:
   > *"If you go up to the main factory door and twist the very bottom rivet of the icon three times to the right, it will open."*

---

## The Factory Endurance Room (Testing Chamber)

* **Script:** [`quests/poinnovation/encounters/EnduranceRoom.lua`](file:///c:/code/EQMacEmu/quests/poinnovation/encounters/EnduranceRoom.lua)
* **Location:** Factory entrance testing chamber.
* **Mechanic:** A timed survival gauntlet against 4 escalating waves of clockwork prototypes. Surviving all waves and defeating the Overseer unlocks the Factory door without needing the Xanamech dragon raid.

---

## Raid Leader Quick Cheat-Sheet

* **Tactics Access Requirement:** Slaying Manaetic Behemoth and hailing Giwin Mirakon is the **exclusive requirement** to enter Drunder / Plane of Tactics.
* **Behemoth Area Rampage:** Warn all Rogues, Monks, and Berserkers to stay out of the Area Rampage radius or maintain maximum melee distance.
* **Fire Resist Priority:** Cast Resist Fire and Elemental/Archshielding buffs before pulling Behemoth to minimize damage from the 1500 DD AE [Boom](https://www.pqdi.cc/spell/2321).
* **Don't Forget the Flag:** Giwin Mirakon remains up for 10 minutes. Every member of the raid must hail him before gating.

## Zone Overview & Access Gating

The Plane of Justice serves as the gateway to the upper tiers of the Planes of Power. Mortals enter freely through the Plane of Tranquility. However, progressing deeper into the Planes—specifically to the **Plane of Valor** and **Plane of Storms**—requires proving one's worth before [The Tribunal](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/201075) by completing at least one of the six elemental trials, or completing all six to challenge the ruler of the realm: **The Seventh Hammer**.

### Progression Chain: Mavuin to the Tribunal
1. **Hail Mavuin:** In the basement prison, speak to [#Mavuin](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/201080) (`201080`) to plead his case. Hail him and say *"information"*, then *"plead your case"*.
2. **Face The Tribunal:** In the central courtroom, hail one of the six avatars of [The Tribunal](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/201075) and say *"I am prepared"* while targeted to receive entry into that specific trial chamber.
3. **The Mark of Justice:** Conquering a trial rewards a Mark from that trial's Punisher. Combining all 6 marks in a Mark of Justice bag creates **[The Mark of Justice](https://www.pqdi.cc/item/31599)** (`31599`), which unlocks the door to the Seventh Hammer.

---

## The Six Trials of the Tribunal

Each trial is initiated by hailing an avatar of [The Tribunal](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/201075) and ported into a dedicated trial arena with a 6-player limit per instance (or raid groups coordinated across resets).

```
Trial Progression Architecture:
[The Tribunal] -> Say: "I am prepared" -> Port into Arena -> 
[Controller Spawn] -> 4 Add Waves -> Boss Punisher Spawns -> 
[Boss Slain] -> Signal 12 to Tribunal -> Agent of The Tribunal Spawns -> 
[Hail Agent] -> Receive Trial Mark & Planar Character Flag
```

---

  - After 16 wave mobs are slain (wave 4), [#Punisher of Flame](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/201486) (`201486`) spawns at `(885, -725, 58)`.
  - Defeating the Punisher signals Tribunal 12, despawns the controller, and rewards [Mark of Flame](https://www.pqdi.cc/item/31589).

## Raid Encounter: The Seventh Hammer

* **Script:** [`quests/pojustice/The_Seventh_Hammer.lua`](file:///c:/code/EQMacEmu/quests/pojustice/The_Seventh_Hammer.lua)
* **Access Requirement:** [The Mark of Justice](https://www.pqdi.cc/item/31599) (`31599`) placed on cursor or top inventory slot when clicking trial doors 1–6 in the Tribunal courtroom.
* **Gating Enforcement:** [`quests/pojustice/player.lua`](file:///c:/code/EQMacEmu/quests/pojustice/player.lua#L14-L21) prevents teleporting into the Seventh Hammer chamber if the boss is already engaged in combat.

### NPC Roster

| NPC Name | NPC ID | Role | Level / Class | HP / Max Hit | Key Spells & Abilities |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [The Seventh Hammer](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/201074) | `201074` | Raid Boss | 75 Warrior | ~500,000 HP / 1850 | Summon, Enrage, Flurry, Rampage |
| [#The Tribunal ](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/201423) | `201423` | Invis Spell Trigger | 75 Warrior | Untargetable | Casts [Verdict of Eternity](https://www.pqdi.cc/spell/1108), [Tremor of Judgment](https://www.pqdi.cc/spell/1107) |
| [The Tribunal](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/201427) | `201427` | Visual Observers | 75 Warrior | Untargetable | Tribunal council statues performing animations |

### Combat Timers & Arena Mechanics

```
Pull & Say: "ready to face"
  |
  +--> Timer: 'tremor'  (Initial: 86-95s, Recast: 187s)
  |      Tribunal Animates (1) -> Invis Tribunal Casts [Tremor of Judgment] (Spell 1107)
  |      Effect: 1500 DD PBAoE + 12.0s Spin Stun + Knockback (-300 Magic Resist)
  |
  +--> Timer: 'verdict' (Initial: 181-190s, Recast: 187s)
         Tribunal Animates (42) -> Invis Tribunal Casts [Verdict of Eternity] (Spell 1108)
         Effect: 2000 DD Target AE + 500 HP/tick DoT (-350 Magic Resist)
```

1. **Engagement:** Hailing the Seventh Hammer and saying *"ready to face"* immediately adds the speaker to the hate list and starts the combat timers.
2. **Tremor of Judgment:** Hits every ~187 seconds. Raids must position tanks with their backs against a wall to prevent the massive knockback from propelling them off the platform or breaking line-of-sight.
3. **Verdict of Eternity:** Hits every ~187 seconds. Heavy magic-resist debuff and DoT; requires fast splash cures and high MR buffing.
4. **Wipe / Reset:** If the raid wipes or drops aggro, timer `'stop'` runs for 10 minutes (`600,000 ms`). If not re-engaged within 10 minutes, all combat timers clear and the event resets.

## Raid Encounter: Terris Thule

* **Script:** [`quests/nightmareb/Terris_Thule.lua`](file:///c:/code/EQMacEmu/quests/nightmareb/Terris_Thule.lua)
* **Location:** The elevated stone amphitheater at `(-1850, 0, 140)`.

### NPC Roster

| NPC Name | NPC ID | Role | Level / Class | HP / Max Hit | Key Spells & Abilities |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [Terris Thule](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/221042) | `221042` | Demi-Goddess | 75 Shadowknight | ~750,000 HP / 1850 | Summon, Enrage, Rampage, Unmezzable |

| [A Planar Projection](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/221042) | `221042` | Flagger | 1 Untargetable | Invulnerable | Grants `terris` flag on hail (20m despawn) |

---

### Phase & HP Trigger Breakdown

```
Engage Terris Thule
  |
  +--> 95% HP: Emote ("The sound of a thousand terrified screams...")
  |
  +--> 79% HP: Add Wave 1 (Defilers)
  |      Spawns 1x Defiler for EVERY raider on hate who has dealt damage to Terris!
  |      Mix of Small (Mezable) and Large (CC-immune) Defilers
  |
  +--> 69% HP: Add Wave 2 (Defilers)
  |      Spawns a SECOND wave of 1 Defiler per attacking raider
  |
  +--> 50% HP: [Direption of Dreams] Cast
  |      Spell 3150: Unresistable target AE slow, dispel, and massive stat reduction
  |
  +--> 40% HP: Gargoyles Awaken
  |      4x [a grotesque gargoyle] activate from the corner monolith pillars
  |
  +--> 10% HP: Enrage (10 seconds)
```

#### Defiler Spawn Mechanic (79% & 69% HP)
The number of defilers that spawn is **proportional to the number of players actively dealing damage to Terris Thule**.
* If 40 players have dealt damage, **40 adds will instantly spawn** at `(-1661, -168, 140)`.
* **Strategy:** Have all secondary melee and off-classes hold DPS before 79% and 69%. Only the main tank and primary ranged attackers hit the boss to minimize the total add count.
* Enchanters must immediately lock down the small defilers with Point-Blank AE Mezzes (`Word of Morell`), while off-tanks pick up the large defilers.

#### The 50% Dispel: Direption of Dreams
At 50% HP, Terris casts [Direption of Dreams](https://www.pqdi.cc/spell/3150). Bards and enchanters must immediately rebuff haste, and clerics must heal through the slow penalty.

#### The 40% Gargoyle Activation
At 40% HP, four massive stone statues awaken atop the monoliths. Four pre-assigned off-tanks must immediately taunt and position the gargoyles away from the raid while main DPS burns down Terris Thule.

---

### Leash & Wipe Reset Boundary
* **Tether Boundary:** Every 1 second, the script checks Terris' location:
  `X > -1580 or X < -2090 or Y > 250 or Y < -280`
* **Penalty:** If pulled down the stairs or into the hallway, Terris immediately emotes:
  > *"Terris Thule disappears into the ether and reforms at the center of her chamber, cleansed of your magic!"*
* She warps back to her center spawn, wipes her hate list, casts [Balance of the Nameless](https://www.pqdi.cc/spell/3230) (full dispel), heals back to **100% HP**, and depops all adds.

---

### Victory & Planar Progression Flag

* Upon defeating Terris Thule, [A Planar Projection](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/221042) spawns at her corpse.
* **Hail the Projection:** Every member of the raid must hail to receive the `terris` character flag.
* **Progression Significance:** Required to enter the **Plane of Torment** and complete the **Saryrn** raid.

---

## Raid Leader Quick Cheat-Sheet

* **Controlled DPS at 80% & 70%:** Stop all non-essential melee DPS before 79% and 69% to limit the number of spawned Defilers.
* **AE Crowd Control:** Have Enchanters chain-cast PBAoE mez at the defiler spawn coordinates (`-1661, -168, 140`).
* **Keep Terris in the Center:** Never pull Terris Thule toward the stairs or chamber entrance; she will leash and reset to 100% HP.
* **Gargoyle Assignments:** Pre-assign 4 off-tanks to grab the 4 corner gargoyles at 40% HP so the raid can burn Terris straight through to 0%.

---

## The Bertoxxulous Event Chain

The Bertoxxulous raid is a multi-tier gauntlet divided into four major phases:

```
Phase 1: The Three Chapel Warders
  [Abroan Drian] + [Breddan Rutyl] + [Fran Prisoal] Slain
       |
Phase 2: Carprin Deatharn & Sanctum Priests
  Shield Fades -> [#Carprin Deatharn] Slain -> Slay 4 Priests

### Phase 1 & 2: Carprin Deatharn & The Chapel Guardians

* **Carprin Mechanics:** Level 65 Shadowknight. Has a periodic **tank hate reduction** mechanic (`drophate`). Off-tanks must build steady aggro.
* Slaying Carprin triggers four lower chamber priests:
  - [#Avhi Escron](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/200228) (`200228`)

### Phase 4: The 12 Adan Minis & The Trash Waves

* **Script:** [`quests/codecay/encounters/Bertox.lua`](file:///c:/code/EQMacEmu/quests/codecay/encounters/Bertox.lua)

#### The Four Final Priests

1. **Rampage & Tank Swapping:** Bertoxxulous hits exceptionally hard with rapid flurries and single Rampage. A designated rampage tank and secondary tank must maintain top positions on hate.
2. **Plague & Disease AEs:** Bertoxxulous casts massive disease DoTs, stat debuffs, and mana siphons. Clerics, Druids, and Shamans must cycle [Pure Blood](https://www.pqdi.cc/spell/1568) and Radiant Cure.
3. **Planar Flagging:**

* **Event Pacing:** Phase 4 has a strict **123-minute timer**. Keep DPS moving efficiently through the trash waves and pull the Adan minis immediately as they spawn.
* **Keep Melee Healed on Carprin:** Carprin Deatharn has random hate drops; be prepared for him to turn on secondary melee unexpectedly.
* **Ultor Complete Heal:** Assign Rogues and Monks to stun/interrupt High Priest Ultor Szanvon to prevent Complete Heal casts.
* **Disease Resist Above All:** Disease Resistance must be capped at 300+ across the entire raid to survive Bertoxxulous' aura of rot.

```

  +--> Phase 2: The Arena Gauntlet (4 Waves)

## Zone Overview & Access Gating

Ragrax, Stronghold of the Twelve is the subterranean mountain fortress where the **Council of the Rathe** presides over the material fabric of creation. 
* **Entrance:** Located at the grand tomb portal at the far end of the Plane of Earth A (`poeartha`).
* **Prerequisite:** Players must possess the character flag from **A Mystical Arbitor of Earth**.
* **Zone Architecture:** A sequential fortress siege divided into four locked chambers: Outer Gates (Doors 2 & 3), The Chieftains' Courtyard, The Warlord's Keep (Doors 4 & 5), and the Inner Sanctum of the Council of Twelve.

---

## Phase 1: The Outer Stone Gates (Doors 2 & 3)

* **Script:** [`quests/poearthb/player.lua`](file:///c:/code/EQMacEmu/quests/poearthb/player.lua#L9-L26)

  > *"As you attempt to move the wall of stone it is clear that it is being held in place by a powerful force."*

## Phase 2: The Three War Chieftains

* **Scripts:** 
  - [`#War_Chieftan_Awisano.lua`](file:///c:/code/EQMacEmu/quests/poearthb/%23War_Chieftan_Awisano.lua)
  - [`#War_Chieftan_Birak.lua`](file:///c:/code/EQMacEmu/quests/poearthb/%23War_Chieftan_Birak.lua)

* Slaying packs of 4 named guards spawns their respective War Chieftain:
  1. Kill 4x [A Myrmidon of Stone](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/222008) $\rightarrow$ Spawns [#War Chieftan Awisano](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/222037).
  2. Kill 4x [A Stonefist Clansman](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/222009) $\rightarrow$ Spawns [#War Chieftan Birak](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/222035).

* Slaying all 3 Chieftains triggers the immediate spawn of **Warlord Gintolaken**.

## Phase 3: Warlord Gintolaken & Inner Fortress (Doors 4 & 5)

* **Script:** [`quests/poearthb/#Warlord_Gintolaken.lua`](file:///c:/code/EQMacEmu/quests/poearthb/%23Warlord_Gintolaken.lua)
* **Stats:** Level 77 Giant Warrior, 1,050,000 HP, hits 551 – 2,212.
* **Combat Mechanics:**
  - **Area Rampage:** Melee DPS must stay at absolute maximum melee range.
  - **Tank Hate Reduction:** Every ~45 seconds on average (`math.random() < 1/45`), Gintolaken drops his primary target's hate **down to 5%**. Secondary tanks must constantly build heavy aggro.
  - **Procs / Spells:** Procs [Gravel Rain](https://www.pqdi.cc/spell/2823) (6s Stun/Pushback) and casts [Storm Comet](https://www.pqdi.cc/spell/1042) (1,200 Cold DD).
  - **Leash Boundary:** If pulled past `X < -137`, he immediately warps home, wipes his hate list, and casts [Balance of the Nameless](https://www.pqdi.cc/spell/3230) (full dispel/reset).
  - **Memblur / Evade Penalty:** If disengaged below 50% HP, he warps home and instantly heals **30% of his maximum HP**.
* **Unlocks on Death:**
  1. Opens Doors 4 & 5 to the Council Chamber once all 25 courtyard trash mobs (`DOOR2_IDS`) are cleared.
  2. **Removes the Council Anti-Cheat Lock (Spawn `369490`) for 3.5 days.** *(The Rathe Councilmen cannot have their damage reduced until Gintolaken is slain!)*

---

## Phase 4: The Council of the Rathe (The Twelve)

* **Script:** [`quests/poearthb/A_Rathe_Councilman.lua`](file:///c:/code/EQMacEmu/quests/poearthb/A_Rathe_Councilman.lua)
* **Setup:** 12 Councilmen stand in the inner chamber. Six are **Mezable** (`222003`) and six are **Unmezable** (`222039`).
* **Combat Abilities & Spells:**
  - Casts [Earthen Vengeance](https://www.pqdi.cc/spell/3074): 100 range PBAoE, 1,000 instant DD, 200 HP/tick DoT, 20% slow, and 4 Curse counters (resisted at Magic -400).
  - **Teleport Trap (Every 60s):** Unless mezzed or brought below 11% HP, each active Councilman chooses a random player on hate within 600 units and teleports them into one of the 4 outer pit drop zones (`Z = -255`).

### The Disempowerment Mechanic (HP Tiers)
Each Councilman begins at full strength (hitting up to 2,964). As their health is brought past specific breakpoints, dirt falls away and their combat stats drastically decline:

```
[100% - 75% HP]  Hits: 623 - 2,964 | Accuracy: 350 | ATK: 30 | Teleports: Active
[ 74% - 50% HP]  Hits: 533 - 2,498 | Accuracy: 350 | ATK: 30 | Teleports: Active
[ 49% - 25% HP]  Hits: 444 - 2,032 | Accuracy: 350 | ATK: 30 | Teleports: Active
[ 24% - 11% HP]  Hits: 354 - 1,566 | Accuracy: 350 | ATK: 30 | Teleports: Active
[  Below 11% HP] Hits: 185 -   850 | Accuracy:   0 | ATK:  0 | Teleports: DISABLED
```
> Emote on down-rank: *"The ground shudders beneath your feet as flecks of dirt and stone fall away from one of the Rathe."*

* **The 10-Minute Mez Rule:** If an enchanter keeps a mezable councilman mezzed continuously for **10 minutes (600 seconds)**, the Councilman **completely wipes his hate list**.
* **Synchronized Burn:** Once all 12 are reduced to <11% HP (where accuracy is 0 and teleports are disabled), the raid coordinates DPS to systematically execute all 12 before respawn timers trigger a full council repop.

---

* **Script:** [`quests/poearthb/#Avatar_of_Earth.lua`](file:///c:/code/EQMacEmu/quests/poearthb/%23Avatar_of_Earth.lua)

### Boss Stats & Abilities
* Level 80 Warrior, 500,000 HP, hits 588 – 1,958. Single Rampage, Enrage (at 10% HP).
* **Spells:**
  - [Ashen Form](https://www.pqdi.cc/spell/3913): Single target, 200 range, unresistable (-350 MR), increases target's Aggro Multiplier by **+95%** (causes the current tank to generate massive hate).
  - [Marl](https://www.pqdi.cc/spell/3914): 300-radius PBAoE, unresistable (-350 MR), inflicts **36 Curse Counters**, a 100 HP/tick DoT, and increases mana consumption. Paladin/Cleric Curse cure rotation is mandatory.
* **Timer:** Has a 2.5-hour despawn timer (`9,000,000 ms`), paused while actively engaged in combat.

### Victory & Planar Flagging
* Upon defeating the Avatar, [Essence of Earth](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/222041) spawns at his corpse.
* Up to 72 eligible raiders hail the Essence to receive:
  **[Mound of Living Stone](https://www.pqdi.cc/item/29146)** (`29146`).
* Essential component required for the **Quintessence of Elements** / **Plane of Time**.

---

## Raid Leader Quick Cheat-Sheet

* **Gintolaken Positioning:** Keep Gintolaken east of `X = -137` to avoid leash resets; prepare secondary tanks for the 45s hate reduction.
* **Council Split Assignments:** Assign 6 Enchanters to the Mezable Councilmen (`222003`) and 6 Off-Tanks to the Unmezable Councilmen (`222039`).
* **The 11% Milestone:** Focus one Councilman at a time down to **under 11% HP** to zero out his accuracy and disable his 60s teleports.
* **Marl Curse Curing:** Have Paladins and Clerics pre-target heal groups with Remove Greater Curse to clear [Marl](https://www.pqdi.cc/spell/3914) (36 counters).

  |      Three rapid waves of water elementals and fierce piranhas

## Raid Leader Quick Cheat-Sheet

* **Mud Ring Red Mudwalkers:** When testing or clearing Red Mudwalkers, **never use `#kill`**; use real damage spells or `#damage` to ensure the 4 runners per mob spawn properly.
* **Coordinate the Four Rings:** Rings can be completed in any order, but all four must be completed in the same instance for the Arbitor to spawn.
* **Arbitor Tanking:** Rotate taunts between 3 warrior tanks to handle periodic hate list drops.
* **Hail for Earth B Access:** Every player must hail [A Planar Projection](https://www.pqdi.cc/npc/218412) before leaving the zone.
